[[Markis]] is a member of the [[Shining Blade]] who first meets the players at the end of [[The Wilds]] [[mission]]. Later, he is revealed to be a spy for the [[White Mantle]] and betrays the whereabouts of the [[Henge of Denravi]] and the meeting place with [[Vizier Khilbron]], which leads to the crippling of the Shining Blade and the capture of [[Evennia]] and [[Saidra]]. He is eventually killed by the players at the [[Iron Mines of Moladune]].

== Notes ==
* After Markis dies, two additional [[Jade Armor]]s spawn, and the mission will not end until those are dead as well, giving players time to capture [[Barrage]].
** Alternatively if the aim is to capture Barrage, a member of the party can use [[Heart of Shadow]] (or [[Viper's Defense]]) to [[shadow step]] from the first bridge onto the level below, and the team can then use additional [[Shadow step#To ally|shadow steps]] to get to that party member. Avoiding crossing the end of the first bridge means that Markis does not begin running towards the end of the mission, and so the groups up to him can then be cleared out at the team's leisure.
* There is a spelling error in his dialogue. He says "vengence" instead of "vengeance".
